subject: DI02000161

title.en: 1.1 Analog versus digital and positional numbers
title.gu: 1.1 Analog સામે Digital તથા Positional Numbers

h.en: Analog versus digital and positional numbers
h.gu: Analog સામે Digital તથા Positional Numbers

body.en:
Understand the idea

Analog varies continuously;digital information uses discrete symbols.A binary digit has two logical values,not necessarily exactly0V and5V.

Explanation and application

  • A thermometer voltage can change smoothly;a binary word encodes a quantised measurement.Digital circuits still use real analog voltages and finite thresholds.
  • Radix r uses digits0to r−1.Decimal uses10digits,binary2,octal8 and hexadecimal16;hex A,B,C,D,E,F mean10,11,12,13,14,15.
  • Each place has weight r^i to the left and r^−i to the right of the radix point.Write the base to prevent ambiguity:10₂ is2₁₀,not ten.
  • A bit is one binary digit;a nibble has4bits and a byte8bits.Leading zeroes do not change an unsigned value but do define word width.
Why state the base?

10₂means2₁₀;the same digit string has different place weights in another base.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Analog continuously બદલાય છે;digital માહિતી discrete symbolsથી દર્શાવાય છે.Binary digitના બે logical values હોય છે;તે હંમેશાં exactly0V/5V હોતા નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Thermometer voltage smoothly બદલાય;binary word quantised measurement encode કરે.Digital circuitમાં પણ actual analog voltages અને finite thresholds હોય છે.
  • Radix rમાં0થી r−1digits છે.Decimalમાં10,binaryમાં2,octalમાં8 તથા hexમાં16digits છે.Hex A,B,C,D,E,Fનો અર્થ10,11,12,13,14,15છે.
  • Radix pointની ડાબે weight r^i અને જમણે r^−i છે.Base લખો:10₂નો અર્થ2₁₀છે,દસ નહિ.
  • Bit એક binary digit છે;નિબલ4bits અને byte8bits છે.Leading zeros unsigned value બદલતાં નથી,પણ word width નક્કી કરે છે.
Base શા માટે લખવું?

10₂એ2₁₀છે;બીજાbaseમાં એજdigitstringનાplaceweightsજુદાછે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Conversion changes representation,not the represented quantity.

Explanation and application

  • To convert an integer to base r,repeatedly divide by r and collect remainders from last to first.Validate that every remainder is a legal digit.
  • For a fraction,repeatedly multiply by r and read integer parts in forward order.Some decimal fractions repeat in binary;state precision rather than silently truncating.
  • For base r to decimal,sum digit×place weight.Separate integer and fraction calculations,then add and reverse-check the answer.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Conversionમાં representation બદલાય છે,quantity નહિ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Integerને base rમાં ફેરવવા વારંવાર rથી divide કરો;remainders છેલ્લાથી પહેલાં વાંચો.દરેક remainder legal digit હોવો જોઈએ.
  • Fractionને વારંવાર rથી multiply કરીને integer parts આગળના ક્રમે વાંચો.કેટલાક decimal fractions binaryમાં repeating હોય છે;precision લખો.
  • Base rથી decimal માટે digit×place-weightનો sum લો.Integer/fraction અલગ ગણો,પછી ઉમેરો તથા reverse-check કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Because8=2³ and16=2⁴,grouping replaces lengthy division.

Explanation and application

  • For octal,group3bits outward from the radix point;for hex,group4bits.Pad the outer ends only:integer side on the left,fraction side on the right.
  • 110101.11₂ →110 101.110₂=65.6₈;0011 0101.1100₂=35.C₁₆.Padding across the radix point changes value.
  • Octal↔hex is easiest through binary:7A₁₆=0111 1010₂=001 111 010₂=172₈.Each octal digit expands to3bits;each hex digit to4.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

8=2³ તથા16=2⁴હોવાથી groupingથી lengthy division ટળે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Octal માટે radix pointથી બહારની તરફ3bits તથા hex માટે4bitsના groups લો.Integerની ડાબે અને fractionની જમણે જ padding કરો.
  • 110101.11₂ →110 101.110₂=65.6₈;0011 0101.1100₂=35.C₁₆.Radix pointની પાર padding કરવાથી value બદલાય.
  • Octal↔hex binary મારફતે સરળ છે:7A₁₆=0111 1010₂=001 111 010₂=172₈.Octal digitના3 તથા hex digitના4bits લો.

title.en: 1.4 Binary arithmetic with carries and borrows

h.en: Binary arithmetic with carries and borrows

body.en:
Understand the idea

Use the same positional method as decimal,but carry at2 rather than10.

Explanation and application

  • Addition rules:0+0=0,0+1=1,1+1=10,1+1+1=11.1011+0110=10001;four-bit storage would retain0001with an unsigned carry.
  • Subtraction:borrow1from the next position gives10₂ in the current position.10110−01101=01001.
  • Multiplication uses shifted partial products:101×11=101+1010=1111.Division uses compare,subtract and shift:1101÷11=100remainder1.
  • State unsigned or signed interpretation.Word truncation,unsigned carry and signed overflow are different;do not infer all from the same carry bit.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Decimal જેવી positional method લો,પણ10ને બદલે2પર carry થાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Addition rules:0+0=0,0+1=1,1+1=10,1+1+1=11.1011+0110=10001;four-bit storageમાં0001અને unsigned carry રહે.
  • Subtractionમાં આગળની positionમાંથી1borrow કરતાં હાલની positionમાં10₂મળે.10110−01101=01001.
  • Multiplicationમાં shifted partial products લો:101×11=101+1010=1111.Divisionમાં compare/subtract/shift:1101÷11=100remainder1.
  • Unsigned/signed interpretation લખો.Word truncation,unsigned carry તથા signed overflow અલગ છે;એક carry bitથી બધું ન નક્કી કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Choose width before complementing;otherwise the representation and sign range change.

Explanation and application

  • For n bits,one’s complement inverts every bit;two’s complement inverts and adds1,keeping n bits.One’s complement has positive and negative zero;two’s complement has one zero.
  • One’s-complement subtraction adds complement of the subtrahend.If carry occurs,add it back as end-around carry;without carry,complement the sum and prefix a minus sign.
  • Two’s-complement subtraction adds the two’s complement of the subtrahend.Discard carry beyond the selected width;interpret the result consistently.
  • 4-bit signed two’s-complement range is−8 to +7. 0111+0001=1000is signed overflow,although the four-bit result is the correct modulo16sum.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Complement પહેલાં width પસંદ કરો;નહિ તો representation/sign range બદલાય.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • n bitsમાં one’s complement બધા bits invert કરે;two’s complementમાં invert પછી1ઉમેરી n bits રાખો.One’s complementમાં બે zero representations છે;two’sમાં એક.
  • One’s subtractionમાં subtrahendનું complement ઉમેરો.Carry આવે તો end-around carry ઉમેરો;carry ન આવે તો sumનું complement લઈને minus sign લગાવો.
  • Two’s subtractionમાં subtrahendનું two’s complement ઉમેરો.Selected widthની બહારનો carry discard કરીને resultનું consistent interpretation કરો.
  • 4-bit signed two’s range−8થી+7છે.0111+0001=1000માં signed overflow છે,ભલે modulo16sum સાચો હોય.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Compute7−3and3−7;bits are fixed at4.

Step-by-step solution

  1. 7−3:0111+1100=1 0011;end-around1→0100(one’s method).Two’s:0111+1101=1 0100→0100.
  2. 3−7:0011+1000=1011;no end carry;one’s complement0100→−4.Two’s:0011+1001=1100→−4.
  3. Magnitude check:7−3=4and3−7=−4.1100means12unsigned but−4signed two’s complement.

Interpretation and check

Carry handling differs between the methods;never combine both rules.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Compute7−3and3−7;bits are fixed at4.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. 7−3:0111+1100=1 0011;end-around1→0100(one’s method).Two’s:0111+1101=1 0100→0100.
  2. 3−7:0011+1000=1011;no end carry;one’s complement0100→−4.Two’s:0011+1001=1100→−4.
  3. Magnitude check:7−3=4and3−7=−4.1100means12unsigned but−4signed two’s complement.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

બંને methodsમાં carry handling અલગ છે;બંને rules ભેગાં ન કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A code represents symbols;it need not represent the whole quantity as a straight binary integer.

Explanation and application

  • 8421BCD is weighted and encodes each decimal digit separately.59₁₀ becomes0101 1001BCD,not00111011binary;1010through1111are invalid BCD digit codes.
  • Excess-3 encodes each decimal digit after adding3:decimal59 →1000 1100.It is nonweighted and self-complementing digitwise.
  • Gray is nonweighted;adjacent codewords in the standard reflected sequence differ in one bit.Binary→Gray:copy MSB,then XOR adjacent binary bits.Gray→binary:copy MSB,then cumulative XOR.
  • Binary1011→Gray1110;Gray1110→binary1011.Gray reduces transition ambiguity in position encoding,but is not an ordinary arithmetic code.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Code symbolsનું representation છે;તે આખી quantityનો straight binary integer હોવો જરૂરી નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • 8421BCD weighted છે અને દરેક decimal digit અલગ encode કરે.59₁₀નું BCD0101 1001છે,00111011binary નહિ;1010થી1111invalid BCD digit codes છે.
  • Excess-3માં દરેક decimal digitમાં3ઉમેરી encode કરો:decimal59 →1000 1100.તે nonweighted તથા digitwise self-complementing છે.
  • Gray nonweighted છે;standard reflected sequenceમાં પડોશી codewords એક bitથી જુદા પડે.Binary→Grayમાં MSB copy અને adjacent binary bits XOR કરો.Gray→binaryમાં MSB copy પછી cumulative XOR કરો.
  • Binary1011→Gray1110;Gray1110→binary1011.Position encodingમાં Gray transition ambiguity ઘટાડે છે,પણ ordinary arithmetic code નથી.

body.en:
Aim

Convert across bases and verify arithmetic with declared word width.

Instruments and preparation

  • Use the approved low-voltage current-limited trainer,verified logic ICs/breadboard,defined input switches,logic probe or high-impedance meter,and exact device datasheet.A simulated/numerical practical needs its stated tools instead.
  • Check package orientation and recommended VCCbefore connecting.Power OFFfor wiring;do not apply a9Vbattery directly to74LSlogic;trainer0–30Vcapability is not an IC operating rating.

Circuit connections / setup

Use written place-value columns or an offline calculation worksheet;there is no breadboard requirement.

Procedure

  1. Derive the expected table first;declare bit order,active polarity and any enable/clock assumptions.
  2. Inspect the unpowered connections against the labelled logic diagram and approved pin map;verify common ground and a suitable local decoupling capacitor.
  3. Test45.625decimal,7Ahex,13÷3binary and both7−3/3−7complement subtraction.
  4. Read each output after settling;for sequential circuits record current state,command,clock event and next state separately.
  5. On a mismatch,stop and trace supply,input definition,polarity and intermediate nodes;power OFFbefore changing wiring.
  6. Save genuine results and explain each discrepancy;power down safely.Do not fill actual observations with expected numbers or claim an unperformed experiment.

Expected calculations and interpretation

Expected:45.625=101101.101₂;7Ahex=172octal;1101÷11=100remainder1.

Fault finding

A sign/width mismatch can mimic an arithmetic error;reverse-convert to decimal before changing the method.

Precautions

  • Never short outputs or exceed ratings;unused inputs must be defined.Output LEDloads need a checked driver/current limiter;an LEDwired to VCCmay indicate logicLOWwhen lit.
  • Use only isolated approved low-voltage apparatus;do not connect mains to logic circuits.A safe trainer is not a guarantee against reversed supply or incorrect pinout.

પ્રક્રિયા

  1. પહેલાં expectedtablederiveકરો.Bitorder,activepolarityતથા enable/clockassumptionsલખો.
  2. Unpoweredconnectionsને logicdiagram/approvedpinmapસાથે તપાસો.Common ground તથા યોગ્ય localdecouplingcapacitorજુઓ.
  3. 45.625decimal,7Ahex,13÷3binary તથા7−3/3−7complement subtractionલો.
  4. Settleથયા પછી દરેકoutputવાંચો.Sequentialમાં currentstate,command,clockevent/nextstateઅલગલખો.
  5. Mismatchમાં રોકાઈ supply,inputdefinition,polarity/intermediatenodestraceકરો.Wiringબદલતાંપહેલાં powerOFFકરો.
  6. Genuine resultsસાચવો,discrepancyસમજાવો અને safelypowerdownકરો.Expectednumbersactualobservationsમાં નભરો;નકરેલ experimentનો દાવો નકરો.

Fault Finding

Aim

Build a binary-to-Gray network with logic gates.

Instruments and preparation

  • Use the approved low-voltage current-limited trainer,verified logic ICs/breadboard,defined input switches,logic probe or high-impedance meter,and exact device datasheet.A simulated/numerical practical needs its stated tools instead.
  • Check package orientation and recommended VCCbefore connecting.Power OFFfor wiring;do not apply a9Vbattery directly to74LSlogic;trainer0–30Vcapability is not an IC operating rating.

Circuit connections / setup

Connect B3directly to G3;XOR B3/B2→G2,B2/B1→G1,B1/B0→G0.Use three XOR channels with common supply/ground.

Procedure

  1. Derive the expected table first;declare bit order,active polarity and any enable/clock assumptions.
  2. Inspect the unpowered connections against the labelled logic diagram and approved pin map;verify common ground and a suitable local decoupling capacitor.
  3. Sweep all16binary words;also check adjacent Gray words differ by one bit.
  4. Read each output after settling;for sequential circuits record current state,command,clock event and next state separately.
  5. On a mismatch,stop and trace supply,input definition,polarity and intermediate nodes;power OFFbefore changing wiring.
  6. Save genuine results and explain each discrepancy;power down safely.Do not fill actual observations with expected numbers or claim an unperformed experiment.

Expected calculations and interpretation

1011binary must give1110Gray;decode that Gray word back to1011.

Fault finding

Wrong bit ordering often gives a plausible but incorrect Gray code.Label MSB/LSB on the panel.

Precautions

  • Never short outputs or exceed ratings;unused inputs must be defined.Output LEDloads need a checked driver/current limiter;an LEDwired to VCCmay indicate logicLOWwhen lit.
  • Use only isolated approved low-voltage apparatus;do not connect mains to logic circuits.A safe trainer is not a guarantee against reversed supply or incorrect pinout.

Explanation and application

Aim

Convert across bases and verify arithmetic with declared word width.

Instruments and preparation

  • Use the approved low-voltage current-limited trainer,verified logic ICs/breadboard,defined input switches,logic probe or high-impedance meter,and exact device datasheet.A simulated/numerical practical needs its stated tools instead.
  • Check package orientation and recommended VCCbefore connecting.Power OFFfor wiring;do not apply a9Vbattery directly to74LSlogic;trainer0–30Vcapability is not an IC operating rating.

Circuit connections / setup

Use written place-value columns or an offline calculation worksheet;there is no breadboard requirement.

Procedure

  1. Derive the expected table first;declare bit order,active polarity and any enable/clock assumptions.
  2. Inspect the unpowered connections against the labelled logic diagram and approved pin map;verify common ground and a suitable local decoupling capacitor.
  3. Test45.625decimal,7Ahex,13÷3binary and both7−3/3−7complement subtraction.
  4. Read each output after settling;for sequential circuits record current state,command,clock event and next state separately.
  5. On a mismatch,stop and trace supply,input definition,polarity and intermediate nodes;power OFFbefore changing wiring.
  6. Save genuine results and explain each discrepancy;power down safely.Do not fill actual observations with expected numbers or claim an unperformed experiment.

Expected calculations and interpretation

Expected:45.625=101101.101₂;7Ahex=172octal;1101÷11=100remainder1.

Fault finding

A sign/width mismatch can mimic an arithmetic error;reverse-convert to decimal before changing the method.

Precautions

  • Never short outputs or exceed ratings;unused inputs must be defined.Output LEDloads need a checked driver/current limiter;an LEDwired to VCCmay indicate logicLOWwhen lit.
  • Use only isolated approved low-voltage apparatus;do not connect mains to logic circuits.A safe trainer is not a guarantee against reversed supply or incorrect pinout.

Actual observations:blank learner evidence

  5. On a mismatch,stop and trace supply,input definition,polarity and intermediate nodes;power OFFbefore changing wiring.
  6. Save genuine results and explain each discrepancy;power down safely.Do not fill actual observations with expected numbers or claim an unperformed experiment.

Expected calculations and interpretation

1011binary must give1110Gray;decode that Gray word back to1011.

Fault finding

Wrong bit ordering often gives a plausible but incorrect Gray code.Label MSB/LSB on the panel.

Precautions

  • Never short outputs or exceed ratings;unused inputs must be defined.Output LEDloads need a checked driver/current limiter;an LEDwired to VCCmay indicate logicLOWwhen lit.
  • Use only isolated approved low-voltage apparatus;do not connect mains to logic circuits.A safe trainer is not a guarantee against reversed supply or incorrect pinout.
